gaps.explanation: The detail revenue lines come from the Budget and Actual (Budget Basis) General Fund statement (trimmed p5, Total revenues actual 3,417,008), a cash receipts basis; the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance (p4, Total revenues 3,446,066) is modified accrual. Row differences (statement p4 - budget p5): Ambulance services 25,052 - 7,481 = +17,571; EMT training 101,681 - 100,830 = +851; Infrastructure development 174,468 - 124,734 = +49,734; Contributions from Boys Town 3,024,626 - 3,063,724 = -39,098; all other rows equal. 17,571 + 851 + 49,734 - 39,098 = 29,058 = gap. Both printed totals are as printed; no detail fix.
